answer_1.quote: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) demonstrate increasing success in real-world vision-language tasks...
answer_1.outputs: The models generate responses to prompts about object color and size based on images, such as answering 'What color is this strawberry?' or 'What color are most strawberries?'

answer_2.quote: We achieve at least a 98% success rate in flipping model predictions from world knowledge to counterfactual answers in the color task for all models.

answer_3.quote: Sampled images are then evaluated using GPT-4o, which scores them based on object correctness, color accuracy, presence of a white background, and overall realism.
